GameSave.title: GameSave
GameSave.description: Stores an authenticated player's serialized music career save snapshot.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the save owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the save record was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the save record was last updated.

/game_saves/{userId}.description: Per-user music career cloud save document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.
